name: no-campaign-ran
about: A day with no campaign spending: no campaign rows, the month's spend so far, and the cohorts.

output.headline: No campaigns ran on November 3, 2026, so there was no spend, no impressions, no clicks, and no leads for the day.
points: November 2026 has 28 days left, and the only spend recorded so far this month is $400.00 on Meta — there is no cost per lead or click rate to report for the day since no ads ran.
The 2026-09-21 cohort produced 38 leads: 33 were contacted (86.8%), 17 converted to applicants (44.7%), 10 applied (26.3%), 4 were hired (10.5%), and 8 were lost after conversion (21.1%).
The 2026-09-28 cohort produced 40 leads: 36 were contacted (90.0%), 20 converted to applicants (50.0%), 12 applied (30.0%), 5 were hired (12.5%), and 9 were lost after conversion (22.5%).
The 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads so far — 9 contacted, 3 converted to applicants, 1 applied, 1 lost after conversion, and no hires yet — but it is too young to judge its rates.
Qualified leads and leads lost before becoming applicants are not recorded in the system for any cohort.
